Detail.document_description: A visual representation of a product that provides information about its appearance, design, and visual characteristics

schema_fields.name: visual_description
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and provide a detailed description of what the product looks like, including shape, design, and overall appearance.

schema_fields.name: colors
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and list all colors visible in the product.

schema_fields.name: primary_color
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and identify the dominant color of the product.

schema_fields.name: materials
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and identify visible materials the product appears to be made of (e.g., metal, plastic, wood, glass).

schema_fields.name: visible_features
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and list visible product features and components.

schema_fields.name: visible_text
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and extract any text visible on the product or packaging.

schema_fields.name: product_condition
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and determine the apparent condition of the product (new, used, etc.).

schema_fields.name: environment
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and describe the environment or setting in which the product is displayed.

schema_fields.name: size_impression
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and provide an impression of the product's size (small, medium, large) based on context.

schema_fields.name: categories
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and identify product categories this item appears to belong to.

schema_fields.name: keywords
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and suggest relevant search terms for the product based on its visual appearance.

schema_fields.name: style
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and identify the style or design aesthetic of the product (modern, traditional, industrial, etc.).

schema_fields.name: target_audience
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and identify the apparent intended audience based on visual design (e.g., professionals, children, etc.).

schema_fields.name: logo_present
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and determine whether a logo is visible on the product.

schema_fields.name: packaging_visible
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product image and determine whether the product packaging is visible in the image.
